basis: frozen (AI-reviewed baseline), reviewed by ChatGPT (GPT-6, AI reviewer), as stated in its review relayed by the repository owner on 2026-11-20

requirements.quote: apply identify communication type with request as comm_type
requirements.reason: Type identified from the request first.
Each branch reads the guideline and verifies load before the draft step, enforced by the order contract.
3P, newsletter and FAQ route to their own files. The else branch falls back to general-comms.

requirements.quote: following the loaded guideline file's specific instructions for formatting, tone, and content gathering
requirements.reason: The draft step requires following the loaded file.

requirements.quote: ask user to clarify the desired communication format
requirements.reason: Clarification is asked only when the type matches neither a known guideline nor general comms. General is the catch-all, so it rarely fires. Unclear formats after routing, including the general fallback, do not trigger a question.

requirements.quote: This skill applies whenever asked to write internal communications in the company's preferred formats: status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports
requirements.reason: Scope listed in Context and the description.
